u0: The initial stage: no siren has sounded yet and the switch has not been flipped. The preference has neither been triggered nor satisfied. The remaining aim is to ensure the switch is flipped at least once if the siren sounds later; flipping it preemptively would also satisfy the preference.
u1: The switch has been flipped at least once, either before or after any siren. The conditional preference is therefore satisfied, and no additional switch flip is needed for it. Later siren activity does not create a new pending obligation under this preference.
u2: The siren has sounded at least once without any switch flip yet, so the preference is pending and currently unmet. The remaining aim is to flip the switch at least once, which answers the siren and satisfies the preference. Until then, waiting or moving without toggling leaves the preference pending, and the siren stays on until it is toggled.
